game.title: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance
game.blurb: Hack and slash action game in which the cyborg Raiden cuts through enemies in Blade Mode, from Platinum Games, released 2013-02-19. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, with the story order taken from StrategyWiki's walkthrough contents.

chapters.title: Files R-00 to R-03
chapters.summary: Guard Duty, Coup d'État, Research Facility and Mile High, plus the challenges inside each File.

chapters.title: Files R-04 to R-07
chapters.summary: Hostile Takeover, Escape from Denver, Badlands Showdown and Assassination Attempt, plus their challenges. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Boss Fights and Revengeance Difficulty
chapters.summary: Beating each boss without taking damage on Hard or above, and S ranks on Revengeance difficulty.

chapters.title: Combat and Blade Mode
chapters.summary: Enemy kill counts, Zandatsu, parries, Ninja Kills, Executions, No Kill battles and Blade Mode cuts.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Secrets
chapters.summary: Customization items, left arms, codec calls, men in boxes, data storage, civilians and Dwarf Gekko friends.

chapters.title: VR Missions
chapters.summary: Unlocking, finishing and top-scoring every VR and DL-VR Mission.

chapters.title: DL-Story-01 (Jetstream)
chapters.summary: The first story add-on, called "Brazilian Wind" in achievement text and "Jetstream" on StrategyWiki.

chapters.title: DL-Story-02: Blade Wolf
chapters.summary: The second story add-on, with Khamsin and Hunt Kills.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a real guide at completion stage 2. Its Walkthrough lists File R-00 to R-07 and two DL-Story pages; File R-00 to R-06 are written (R-05 and R-06 are short, about 1.8 and 2.1 KB), while R-07, both DL-Story pages, the Walkthrough index, Combo List, Characters, Left arms, Data storages, Hostages and Men In Boxes, VR Missions and Ranked battle data are not. Chapter order follows its Table of Contents; File chapters were grouped in fours to keep the chapter count down. metalgear.fandom.com answers the API, with about 136 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Metal Gear Rising". None of the 60 Steam achievements are hidden. The first story add-on is "Brazilian Wind" in achievement text but "DL-Story-01: Jetstream" on StrategyWiki; the chapter title uses both. "You're Hired" has the same description as the base-game Armstrong achievement but sits in the DL-Story-01 block, so it was placed there by position.
